description: Windows download manager with multi-connection downloads, torrents, video capture and browser extensions.
notes: The extracted payload contains ADM.exe at the application root, tools\ffmpeg.exe, tools\yt-dlp.exe, tools\aria2c.exe, and the Chromium/Firefox extension files.

Scoop extracts the application payload only. It does not run the vendor install sections that register HKCU\Software\ASM\ADM, the adm-download:// URL protocol, the optional HKCU startup entry, or vendor Start Menu/Desktop shortcuts. Browser integration relying on that URL protocol and the vendor autostart option are therefore not configured by this manifest.
